i_cliff: A GREEN CLIFF-TOP PLATEAU ON A SUNNY ISLAND above WHITE CHALK CLIFFS that drop sheer into a deep blue sea along the north and west, white surf at their foot; fresh green turf, patches of wind-bent grass with pink sea thrift and white daisies; groups of dark wind-bent sea pines; on a headland reaching into the sea in the north the roofless ruin of a round white watchtower; a pale road of packed earth and crushed shell comes over an old arched white stone bridge across a deep ravine in the south-west and runs north and then east across the plateau; a footpath to the tower. Palette: vivid grass greens, chalk white and pale grey, deep ultramarine and turquoise sea. Breezy, bright, open.
i_cove: A HIDDEN COVE ON A SUNNY ISLAND: in the south a wide crescent BEACH of fine WHITE SAND around a bay of clear turquoise shallows turning deep blue further out, lines of white foam; low WHITE CLIFFS arc behind the beach with a narrow gully where a footpath comes down; on the cliff top in the north green meadow, pines and the main road running west to east; at the foot of the eastern cliff the dark jagged mouth of a SEA CAVE; reefs of dark rock in the shallows, small tide pools on the sand, a few coconut palms. Palette: white sand, turquoise and deep blue water, chalk white, fresh greens. Paradise-like, calm, a little mysterious.
i_cape: THE NECK OF A LONG CAPE ON A SUNNY ISLAND: a narrow ridge of green meadow runs from the south-west to the north between two deep blue seas, its edges ringed by white rocks and surf; wind-bent grass with pink sea thrift and white flowers, a few dark pines and bushes; small cairns of piled white stones; an old wooden signal mast with a crossed yard on a heap of stones; a pale road winds along the top of the ridge from the west edge to the north edge where a village lies. Palette: greens, chalk white, deep blue and turquoise sea. Windswept, lonely, beautiful.
i_light: A SMALL ROCKY ISLAND IN THE OPEN SEA: short green turf and wind-bent grass over white and grey rocks, a flat rock shelf on the crag in the north; on it a tall round LIGHTHOUSE of whitewashed stone with two faded red bands and a dark glass lamp room on top, its small arched door facing south; the roofless ruin of a small keeper's cottage beside it; a footpath climbs from a simple wooden jetty on the south shore; deep blue sea with white surf all around, a turquoise rim of shallows. Palette: white, faded red, greens, deep blue. Lonely and abandoned.
i_siren: A TINY ISLET IN THE OPEN SEA: dark flat rock shelves, patches of white sand and a little grass; in its middle a tall weathered SEA STACK of dark grey rock pierced by round holes, shells and pale coral clinging to its foot; small tide pools; a wooden jetty on the east; deep blue sea all around with turquoise shallows and white surf. Palette: slate greys, white sand, turquoise and deep blue. Eerie, windy, magical.
i_crab: A SANDY TROPICAL ISLET: bright WHITE SAND with a few patches of grass, coconut palms, a small turquoise lagoon; in the middle a big glittering MOUND of seashells, old gold coins and coral (a giant hermit crab's nest); a wooden jetty on the west; ringed by turquoise shallows and deep blue sea. Palette: white sand, palm greens, turquoise, gold. Sunny and playful.
i_wreck: A REEF IN THE OPEN SEA: a long sandbar of white sand and dark wet rock shelves; run aground on it lies a big two-masted wooden MERCHANT SHIP heeled over, its hull holed, sails torn and hanging, crates spilled on the sand beside it; rocks in the surf; a simple wooden jetty on the south for a boat; deep blue sea all around with turquoise shallows. Palette: white sand, dark rock, weathered brown wood, deep blue. Dramatic, a place of misfortune.
